title: nb.plaintext_vector, version 1
description: One line of <dir>/vectors.jsonl, the directory NB_PLAINTEXT_VECTORS names: one plaintext a ciphertext-vector operation (ct + v, ct - v, ct * v) encoded, appended when it is encoded. Its values are in <dir>/pv_<n>.f64. See dsl_fhe/docs/RUN_METADATA.md.

version.description: The schema's version. A consumer rejects a version it does not know.

tag.description: pv:<n>: the n-th such plaintext of the process, from 0, in the order they are encoded. Its values are in pv_<n>.f64 next to this file.

length.description: The number of values: pv_<n>.f64 holds length float64 values, 8 * length bytes.

level.description: The level the plaintext is encoded at.

slots.description: The slot count it is encoded with.

noise_scale_deg.description: The noise scale degree it is encoded with: always 1.
